name: Animal Care Centers of NYC (ACC)
neighborhoods: All 5 boroughs (adoption sites: Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island; Brooklyn closed for renovation, reopening 2026; Bronx full-service opens 2027)
region_note: CITYWIDE BACKBONE & MUNICIPAL (the spine of NYC dog rescue)
notes: The city's only open-admission shelter, 501(c)(3) contracted by NYC; takes in 25,000+ animals/yr regardless of breed/age/medical. Surrender is by appointment only - they push surrender-prevention resources first. Adoption fee waived for veterans and for adopters 60+ taking a pet 6+ yrs; IDNYC = $25 off. Also runs Lost & Found (call before visiting). The first call for both adoption and surrender. Email: (via site forms; surrender questionnaire online)
section: CITYWIDE BACKBONE & MUNICIPAL (the spine of NYC dog rescue)
